summary: Finalised pyproject.toml metadata: readme=README.md, PEP 639 SPDX license wiring (License-Expression: MIT, deprecated License classifier dropped), GitHub Homepage/Repository/Issues/Changelog URLs, and an sdist exclude for .graphloop. Added scripts/smoke_install.sh: builds sdist+wheel, twine-checks both, verifies wheel ships transcriber/py.typed and none of .graphloop/tests/scripts and sdist ships LICENSE+README.md, then installs the wheel into a throwaway venv and exercises the installed CLI (--version matching the built version, --help, formats listing all six formats, mock-engine transcription of a generated WAV with output-file and content assertions). Gate prints PASS and exits 0.
